name: Potion of Giant Strength (Cloud Giant)

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: Your Strength becomes 27 for 1 hour (no effect if it's already higher).
text: The clear liquid holds a floating sliver of cloud giant fingernail. Drink it and your Strength score becomes 27 for 1 hour; a creature whose Strength is 27 or more gains nothing from it.
